title: DocMap location (ubicazione)
description: A node of the location tree (Magazzino › Armadio › Scansia › Scaffale › Scatola) as written by DocMap v12 (normalizeLocation + locIntegrity in assets/js/02c-locations.js): S.locations, workspace JSON, sync packages, server records of type 'location'. code, level and short_url are DERIVED from the tree. Contract: docs/MODELLO-DATI.md §14.1.

parent_id.description: Parent node id; '' = top level (NULL in SQLite). A missing or cyclic parent is repaired to ''.

kind.description: Level label of this node; '' = the configured level name: archive.levels[level] of its archive (v12), else settings.locLevels[level].

seg.description: Code segment (MAG1, A2, B04): uppercase, no spaces and no '-', max 16 characters, unique among siblings (a duplicate becomes B04.2).

code.description: DERIVED path code: segments from the root joined by '-' (MAG1-A2-S3-R1-B04). Not sync content.

short_code.description: Location QR code: 'dm26L' + 8 characters (13 in all), unique, never reused. Binder codes have 12 characters: the type is told by the format alone.

sort.description: Order among siblings; 0 = natural order by seg.

archive_id.description: v12: archive (archive.schema.json) of the tree, '' = the default archive. Set on the top-level node; DERIVED for the others (always the root's archive, repaired by locIntegrity).

updated_at.description: Drives last-write-wins like binders. Moving a node bumps its whole subtree.
